name: iso-prerender
description: An offline pre-rendering pipeline and toolchain for 2:1 isometric sprites: bake the art and its atlases offline, light the scene at runtime. A farming scene is included as a rendering slice. Zero runtime dependencies.
comment: devDependencies are for the offline QA tools only (headless screenshots, the end-to-end test, the timelapse GIF). `build`, `serve` and `single` use nothing but Node built-ins, and nothing in here is shipped to the browser.
